name: Vue Router
description: Routing-specific application concepts from official Vue Router documentation. This profile establishes route-component responsibilities without forcing a specific `views/` or `pages/` folder name.

rules.title: Model routed screens as route components
rules.summary: Vue Router maps routes to components; Harness may recognize route-level components/views but must not claim Vue Router mandates a particular folder name.

sources.title: Getting Started | Vue Router
sources.notes: Official Vue Router guide documents route components, nested routes, views, file-based routing and related navigation concepts.
